_comment: Register each MT5 account as its own MCP server in Claude Code (top-level mcpServers in ~/.claude.json). Each account needs a DISTINCT MT5LINUX_PORT *and* a DISTINCT MT5_WINEPREFIX — one terminal can only hold one login, so sharing a port/prefix makes accounts collide. Clone a prefix per extra account with ./new-account-prefix.sh. Name each server after its account (not 'metatrader') so order tools can't be aimed at the wrong account. Replace the placeholder paths/credentials; do not commit real passwords.
